story.i_want: Update the current API implementation to utilize a real SQL database connection with connection string managed by configuration
story.so_that: The application can persist data reliably across application restarts and support production-grade data storage instead of in-memory repositories

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: SQL repositories implement the same interfaces as in-memory repositories
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the API is configured with a SQL database connection, When a transaction is created, Then it is persisted to the SQL database

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Database context is properly registered in dependency injection
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the application is configured with DbContext, When repositories are instantiated, Then they receive a valid ApplicationDbContext instance

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing API endpoints continue to work with SQL-backed repositories
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the API endpoints are unchanged, When requests are made to transaction and account endpoints, Then they retrieve/persist data from/to SQL database

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given the database is unavailable, When the application starts, Then it fails with a meaningful error message

related_edge_cases.criterion: Concurrent access to database from multiple application instances
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given multiple application instances access the same database, When transactions are created, Then data integrity is maintained

related_edge_cases.criterion: Seed data already exists in database on application restart
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given seed data exists in the database, When the application restarts, Then no duplicate accounts are created

steps.description: Write unit tests for ApplicationDbContext entity mappings and configuration
Write unit tests for SqlTransactionRepository LINQ queries with in-memory database
Write unit tests for SqlAccountRepository balance calculation from transactions
Write integration tests for database connection and migration on startup
depends_on: Write unit tests for ApplicationDbContext entity mappings and configuration

steps.description: Write integration tests for transaction creation end-to-end (API to database)
depends_on: Write unit tests for SqlTransactionRepository LINQ queries with in-memory database

steps.description: Write integration tests for account balance calculation from SQL transactions
depends_on: Write unit tests for SqlAccountRepository balance calculation from transactions

steps.description: Write integration tests for seed data initialization and idempotency
Write integration tests for database connection error handling
Write E2E tests for complete transaction workflow (create account, transaction, retrieve with balance)
depends_on: Write integration tests for transaction creation end-to-end (API to database)

steps.description: Write E2E tests for data persistence across application restarts
depends_on: Write integration tests for seed data initialization and idempotency

steps.description: Write E2E tests for concurrent transaction creation
depends_on: Write integration tests for transaction creation end-to-end (API to database)
